objects.name: Analytic 2264
objects.description: Real-time monitoring identifies Windows firewall changes blocking unsolicited Industrial Control System (ICS) reporting traffic while leaving polling/command traffic unaffected, resulting in Supervisory Control and Data Acquisition (SCADA) losing event-driven visibility while retaining polling capability. OT operational-fidelity gate: Alert only when the action is not attributable to an authorized operator/engineering source for the specific target and function, and it is either outside an approved change/maintenance window or lacks matching change-control context; where telemetry permits, require corroborating device, configuration, or process-state effect. Suppress activity that fully matches approved maintenance, commissioning, failover, recovery, or tested control procedures.
